question: Approve the design and enter implementation as Pilot? Approving accepts the recommendation D1: dispatch_records.py --names also reports a validation record with no Candidate: line (route 3 narrowed), not workers reading the dispatched Package root and not a dispatch hold when the README is behind; and FO's implementation order below.

artifacts.summary: Finding: a worker loads the installed plugin, and nothing in the package can change that (installed_plugins.json has one active entry, 0.24.0). The relay hold was on FO's side: 0.23.0's delivery_gate.py needs a Candidate: line that only the 0.23.0 README told FO to write; reproduced: --names exits 0 silently, delivery_gate.py exits 2 on the same record. Change: one script part, one test, one maintain-flow sentence, no README words. 'Sync later' still means README prose, frontmatter and _mods copies; scripts and skills reach every repository at plugin update. AC-1 to AC-8; baselines for AC-1, AC-6, AC-7 reproduced. Not measured: Codex hosts. Implementation order (FO, from the six Batch overlap sections): workflow-budget-ratchet and prod-security-validation-gate first in parallel; after the ratchet merges, worker-loads-declared-package, ui-design-review-in-ideation and special-role-triggers; merge-gatekeeper after prod-security-validation-gate (both edit delivery_gate.py). At most three workers at once.
